title: The Foxloft
description: Watch results for the Foxloft — a reach of hybrid oaks, devoted hunters, and wildly varied fox-like beasts.

prompts.text: A bone-spit daubed with a rudimentary map of the surrounding waves.
A distant pack of spring-foxes playing in the thrash.
An arconautic swell from somewhere below, letting the crew hear perfectly for a short time.
One of the undercrew shares a tale of the salvagers sent to find the Bottom Dollar, and what they found instead.
An excellent view of one of the Seven Walls from a peak of the wavetops.
A Hunting Family vessel pulls alongside, with fresh meat and strong drink to share and nothing to ask for in return.
A tallshank marked with Raka Spit script, a hunter's poem for prey long-lost.
A bone-spit archipelago settled by refugees from a distant reach.
A brace of trained foxes pulling a Writling pleasure-barge.
An encounter with one of the Bravest Few, atoning for the crime of trophy-theft.
A heavily damaged Hunting Family ship fleeing a leviathan.
A coterie of spring-foxes dancing in the wake of your ship, a decidedly good omen.
A vengeful storm, its lightning striking an insulated Writling dredging-vessel again and again.
A swarm of tiny pocket-foxes spilling up and over the railings, looking to nab any small items they can.
The split banyan-branches and scarred trunks that point to a recently surfaced leviathan.
A Woke-Bone puppet pulling itself onto the deck, screaming for help as it is forced to attack.
